Evidence required before promotion: positive money-weighted holdout net P&L after every cost, positive conservative confidence bound, adequate outcome coverage, stable results across regimes, calibrated executable-edge predictions, reconciled execution failures, and successful existing human/safety promotion gates.

proposals.downside_risk: Fewer routes will qualify and sparse routes may remain dormant longer.

proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 independent holdout opportunities, 30 executable attempts and 20 completed round-trip outcomes per chain/route cohort across multiple market regimes.
proposals.rationale: A positive-only estimator overstates route expectancy and can select routes that lose money after failed execution, revert gas, slippage and adverse price movement.
proposals.shadow_test: Recompute each route using every eligible observation, including zero/negative outcomes and failed-attempt costs, then evaluate on a strictly later holdout window. Pass only if aggregate realised or executable-counterfactual net P&L is positive after all costs, with positive lower confidence bound; stop if any data leakage is found or holdout net P&L is non-positive.

proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 days, 200 eligible signals and 50 independently resolved executable round trips per chain, with at least 20 observations in each materially different cost/volatility regime.
proposals.rationale: Independent post-decision outcomes are required to separate STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures and to measure net expectancy without circular scoring.
proposals.shadow_test: Freeze each signal at decision time, record later executable entry/exit quotes and simulations without look-ahead, and classify outcomes as STRATEGY_MARKET_LOSS, EXECUTION_INFRA_FAILURE or NET_WIN. Include Solana priority/base fees and rent treatment; include EVM gas, reverted-transaction gas, builder fees and price impact. evidence.detail: Solana observations deliberately set gross edge, liquidity and sellability to zero and declare needs_quote_feature_adapter.

proposals.expected_effect: Rejects apparently strong leader signals whose follower-specific executable edge is non-positive and identifies whether losses arise from market selection or execution degradation.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 500 leader events, 100 fully quoted eligible events and 50 resolved round-trip counterfactuals over at least 30 days; report results by latency, notional and liquidity bucket.
proposals.rationale: Copy profitability depends on follower quote timing, route liquidity, entry deterioration, priority fees and exit sellability, not merely the leader's historical return distribution.
proposals.shadow_test: For each observed leader BUY, capture a time-stamped follower-size Jupiter entry quote, sellability probe, simulated transaction costs and later exit-policy quotes. Compare predicted net edge with fully costed counterfactual round-trip net P&L. Fail the hypothesis if money-weighted net P&L is non-positive, execution-cost coverage is incomplete, or positive predictions are not calibrated out of sample.

proposals.downside_risk: Overly conservative reserves may suppress genuinely profitable low-margin opportunities.

evidence.detail: Shared fixed minimum net-edge and quote-age thresholds are applied to both chain types.
EVM costs include estimated gas and builder fees, while the Solana adapter currently has no executable quote costs; their uncertainty and failure economics are therefore not comparable.

proposals.expected_effect: Thresholds become conservative uncertainty reserves derived from observed net-cost distributions, improving abstention when nominal edge is too small to survive execution.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 independently resolved outcomes per chain and 30 per tested cost bucket, including failed executions.
proposals.rationale: A fixed four-to-six basis-point threshold cannot represent chain-specific fixed fees, EVM revert risk, Solana priority-fee variance, latency decay or estimation error.
proposals.shadow_test: Fit no live parameters; bucket SHADOW observations by chain, notional, route and volatility, then compare fixed thresholds with pre-registered cost-plus-uncertainty reserves on a later holdout period. Stop if any bucket has fewer than 30 resolved outcomes or if adaptive thresholds reduce money-weighted net P&L versus abstention.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository contains conservative fail-closed gates and explicitly prohibits promotion from quote simulations, but it cannot establish durable money-weighted net profitability without fresh runtime forensics. Solana SHADOW inputs intentionally lack contemporaneous executable edge, while EVM SHADOW results are derived from the same estimated edge used for eligibility rather than independent future outcomes. Historical route learning also averages only positive proven observations, creating selection bias. These are strategy-evidence limitations, not demonstrated execution or infrastructure failures. No strategy is shown profitable, canary-ready, or live-ready.
